description: Before paying one of several x402 tools for the same task: which ones deliver? The five offers in a category most likely to deliver at their listed terms, by odds from Agoranome's own paid calls, with price, listing and the order rule stated. Sellers the evidence can't tell apart rotate daily, and the answer says whether the odds are validated yet. Takes a category, an optional price cap and network. Read from the daily deliver feed: no new spend, no model call, refused unpaid when stale. Price: $0.002 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Same price over HTTP, which any x402 client pays without MCP (prefer it if your client pays HTTP 402s): GET https://api.agoranome.com/v1/facts/delivers?category=web_search. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.002 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

explore.description: Optional: give the fifth place to the most recently listed seller with an attested sample and no probe yet, labelled exploration
explore.title: Explore

if_none_match.description: Send the answer's ETag back in If-None-Match (over MCP, the if_none_match argument): while the answer is unchanged it comes back as a free 304 Not Modified.
if_none_match.title: If None Match

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.

max_price.description: Optional: only offers at or under this price per call in USD
max_price.title: Max Price

network.description: Optional: only offers whose listing takes USDC on this network's mainnet, at their price there
network.title: Network
